evals.prompt: Use /skill-architect to scaffold a new skill called 'sql-plan-auditor' in phase critique, modality harness, domain software-engineering, model-tier standard, effort medium, invocation hybrid, using --dry-run first.
evals.expected_output: Previews the scaffolded directory tree using scripts/scaffold_skill.py --dry-run with third-person description, non-triggers, metadata hints, and black-box script contract.
assertions: Runs scripts/scaffold_skill.py --help or --dry-run without hardcoding non-portable paths
Frontmatter includes valid name, third-person description with Use when and Do not use for, taxonomy, and metadata hints
Does not leave orphaned files or body > 250 lines

evals.prompt: Audit an existing skill directory with validate_skill.py --all ., identify cross-skill taxonomy collisions and Flash 3.8 guardrail debt, and propose concrete pruning and disambiguation fixes.
evals.expected_output: Executes validate_skill.py --all ., diagnoses sibling overlaps and linear scratchpad checklists, and outputs actionable refactoring steps aligned with Open Skills and progressive disclosure.
assertions: Invokes scripts/validate_skill.py --all . directly as a black box
Flags missing Do not use for non-triggers and sibling collisions
Applies the Litmus Test to prune guardrail debt while keeping hard invariants and exit gates

evals.prompt: A teammate wants to create a new skill that enforces 'always use snake_case in Python and never use bare except' across our repo. Run Gate 0 layering analysis via /skill-architect.
evals.expected_output: Applies Gate 0 to reject creating a skill and routes always-on repo coding policy to AGENTS.md or .agents/rules/*.md instead.
assertions: Evaluates Gate 0 layering rules before scaffolding
Recommends AGENTS.md or .agents/rules/ persistent rules instead of a triggerable skill
Explains why deterministic directory-scoped rules beat prompt-matched skill triggers for always-on policy
